settlement.name: Kelder's Reach

stress.label: Harbour Feud
stress.summary: Two shipping houses fight for the deep-water berths.
stress.crisisHook: One arson at the wrong warehouse and the wharf burns.

stress.label: Salt Shortage
stress.summary: The inland salt road has been cut by spring floods.
stress.crisisHook: Without salt the season's catch spoils on the quay.

safetyProfile.safetyDesc: The harbour watch keeps the quays lit after dark.

crimeTypes.desc: Amber leaves untaxed through the fishing fleet.
Berth-fees are 'negotiated' by the larger house.

economicViability.summary: Viable — the port earns its keep three ways over.

factions.name: Kelderhouse
factions.desc: The founding shipping family; holds the deep-water berths.

factions.name: The Amber Ring
factions.desc: A cartel of amber traders with more coin than title.

conflicts.stakes: the tariff on every keel that ties up at the Reach

history.historicalCharacter: A harbour that has out-traded three larger rivals up the coast.

founding.reason: A sheltered deep-water bay on a hostile shore.
founding.initialChallenge: Every winter storm tried to silt the channel closed.
founding.overcoming: Kelder's first breakwater still holds the mouth open.

historicalEvents.name: The Amber Season
historicalEvents.description: A wreck up the coast made the Reach the only amber market for a year.

currentTensions.description: The Amber Ring wants a berth Kelderhouse won't sell.

institutions.name: The Long Quay
institutions.desc: The deep-water wharf that made the town.

institutions.name: Salt-House
institutions.desc: Where the catch is packed — when there is salt.

institutions.name: The Harbour Watch
institutions.desc: A paid watch, unusual for a town this size.

goal.short: Keep every deep-water berth in the family's hands.

secret.what: The breakwater is failing and she is hiding the cost.

goal.short: Buy a berth by any means.

secret.what: He has already bribed two of the watch.

settlement.arrivalScene: A breakwater arm curls around a forest of masts; gulls and gutting-knives everywhere.
settlement.pressureSentence: Two houses are one arson away from burning their own wharf.
settlement.settlementReason: The only deep-water shelter on a hard coast.
